name: Tag Marketing Vault
body:
> Project · 2026-10-22

# Summary
Kim's private Tag Marketing Vault is a personal knowledge app (prompts, platform accounts, tasks, notes and course lessons). The online version is a claude.ai artifact (claude.ai/artifact/47BvZWWeqCK3wK1rk4V3bS); `Tag Marketing Vault\` is a desktop copy built from the same source, mainly so it can play full-size course videos from local paths.

# Structure (desktop copy)
- `index.html`, `css/vault.css`, `js/vault.js`: the generated page.
- `src/vault-artifact.html`: the source, identical to the published page. Edit this, not the generated files.
- `tools/build_desktop.py`: regenerates the page and `data/seed.js` from `src/` and `data/`.
- `data/seed.js`: starting data exported from the online vault.
- `data/live/`: exported items as JSON, one file per item. Currently `library/` (a Local SEO lesson set, 10 Local SEO lesson pages and a GBP review resource) and `prompts/` (3 sample prompts: GBP post, keyword plus city, LSI startup).
- `assets/`: images.

# Sections in the app
Prompt Library, Learning Center, Resources and Templates, AI and Automations, Platform Accounts, a **Login Credentials** section, tasks and notes. The Logins section exists in the app; its contents are private and are not copied into this vault.

# How saving works
- The desktop copy saves to the browser on this PC and does not sync with the online vault. Use Export backup and Import to move data.
- Rebuilding the seed adds new pages (for example new course notes) without overwriting pages already edited.
- Videos: "Add video" with a full local path; the online vault shows the path as a card because browsers cannot play local files from a website.
- Design preferences: light mode, no emojis, minimal fields.
